signal: AiDash partnered with Spire Global to add space-powered weather intelligence to its utility vegetation risk platform

email.body1:
Bradley, saw AiDash brought Spire Global's weather intelligence into the vegetation risk platform for utilities.

When the product surface expands like that, the signal-to-action gap usually widens: more in-market accounts firing intent than the team can route and touch in time. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AiDash off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bradley, quick follow-up for AiDash.

Most sales ops teams lose pipeline not to bad targeting but to latency: a signal fires, then sits days before anyone acts on it. By the time outreach goes out, the window has cooled and the lift is gone.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best-practice patterns alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent, measurable from week one.
email.body3:
Bradley, last bit of proof for AiDash.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AiDash's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bradley, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running ops across a fast-growing platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion like yours? I'll tailor it to AiDash either way.
